faces.name: Borrowed Knowledge
faces.oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Discard your hand, then draw cards equal to the number of cards in target opponent's hand.
• Discard your hand, then draw cards equal to the number of cards discarded this way.

• Discard your hand, then draw cards equal to the number of cards discarded this way.
